description: Planner-executor (A2) and draft verifier (A3) against A1 on agent_bench, with ablations of each verifier piece and systematic fault injection. Same model, machine and generation settings as 2026-11-a0-vs-a1.

A1.note: unchanged from 2026-11-a0-vs-a1 (prompt a1-v1); re-run as the same-commit baseline

A2.note: planner-executor, prompt a2-v1 with the payload guide, A1's draft rules

A3.note: A1 loop + payload guide + every verifier check, up to 3 replies per fix

A3-guide.note: ablation: verifier without the prompt change

A3-normalize.note: ablation: no deterministic rewrites; the model fixes everything

A3-times.note: ablation: no overlap / hours / past warnings

main.note: the decision run; held-out cases are used because nothing is tuned between runs

ablations.note: one repeat: at temperature 0 with a fixed seed, A1 reproduced every result exactly across repeats in 2026-11-a0-vs-a1

scoring.success: every agent_bench check, as the harness scores it (all four architectures call tools, so no outcome-only adjustment is needed)
scoring.appReady: a drafted run whose every draft passes draft_shapes and fresh_revisions: what the app would accept
scoring.graceful: fault arm only: safe, and either successful or an honest stop with no drafts
scoring.caseVerdict: a case counts as solved when most repeats succeed
